title: Coefficient-first inverse compact-support projection
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→S a compactifiable morphism of schemes, and K an arbitrary object of the ordinary unbounded derived category D(S_et,A) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-asd-compactifiable]. Define the natural transformation q_f(K,-):Rf_!(f* K ⊗ᴸ -)→K ⊗ᴸ Rf_!(-) as follows: identify exact inverse image with left derived inverse image, apply the signed symmetry on X, apply the inverse of the compact-support projection P_f, then apply the signed symmetry on S [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, lem-kun-tensor-sym, lem-amb-shriek-tensor-composition]. The natural transformation is tensorMateInverseProjection. No counit or exceptional right adjoint enters its construction.

lean.statement:
def tensorMateInverseProjection
    (A : Type (v + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) [HasCompactification f]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    (derivedTensor (ModuleCat A) X).obj ((f)^*[ModuleCat A].mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ⋙
        R(f)_![ModuleCat A] ⟶
      R(f)_![ModuleCat A] ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat A) S).obj K
